newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: SKC Ltd, two other S.Korean firms apply for IPOs.
newsitem.headline: SKC Ltd, two other S.Korean firms apply for IPOs.

text.p: SKC Ltd and two other South Korean firms have applied to list initial public offerings on the Seoul bourse, the Securities Supervisory Board said on Wednesday.
SKC Ltd, a video and film manufacturer, plans to offer 4.8 million shares at 14,000 won each. The company is an affiliate of the Sunkyong Group.
Hankook Steel Co Ltd, a cast iron products maker, plans to offer three million shares at 20,000 won per share.
Young Chang Silup Co Ltd, a producer of leather bags and other leather goods, plans to offer 342,608 shares at 11,500 won per share.
An official at the securities watchdog said the offerings were expected to be made in June if the Securities and Exchange Commission approved the applications.
